subject: gk
question: In whose consultation does the President have the power to make rules to the procedure with respect to joint sittings of the two Houses?

options.text: Speaker and Members of Lok Sabha
Speaker, Chairman and Members of Parliament
Chairman and members of Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chairman and Speaker**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The President of India has the power to make rules regarding the procedure for joint sittings of the two Houses of Parliament.
 
• This power is exercised by the President in consultation with the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha and the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
 
• Joint sittings are convened to resolve any deadlock between the two Houses on a particular bill.
 
• The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is also known as the Vice President of India.
 
• The Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over joint sittings of the Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Joint Sitting**

 
 
• It is a mechanism provided by the Constitution to resolve deadlocks between the two Houses of Parliament.
 
• The joint sitting is presided over by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Role of the President**
 
 
• The President can summon a joint sitting of both Houses in case of disagreement on a bill.
 
• The President's role is largely ceremonial but includes significant powers regarding parliamentary procedures.
 
 
 
• **Parliamentary Procedures**
 
 
• Parliamentary procedures include rules and regulations that govern the functioning of the Parliament.
 
• These procedures ensure the smooth functioning of legislative business and the resolution of conflicts.
